title: EOS ledger event
description: One append-only line of .eos/ledger/events.jsonl. `prevHash`/`hash` form a chain, so rewriting or deleting an earlier line is detectable by `eos ledger --verify`.

hv.description: Hash scheme. 2: `hash` covers every field of the event. Absent: an event written before eos-2.6.1, hashed over a fixed list of fields.

evidenceSha256.description: Digest of the evidence file this event recorded. It is part of the hashed body, so the chain protects it and a regenerated evidence file cannot be passed off as the one that was verified.

manifestDigest.description: Approval events only: an approval is given for ONE release manifest, and changing what ships voids it.

assurance.description: Approval events only. `self`: recorded by the person who prepared the work, which a solo project (approvalMode solo, Standard track) may do; shown wherever the approval is shown.

deferredDigest.description: Approval events only: digest of the deferred NFR list the approval was given for. Absent when nothing was deferred.

deferred.description: Approval events only: the deferred NFR targets the approver accepted, kept in the release record.
